---
title: "8_Hallmark_Pathways"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Hallmark gene set enrichment analysis using MSigDB Hallmark
  collection (H category). Over-representation analysis applied
  to shared ALS/PD genes and per-disease robust gene sets.
  GSEA also run using Hallmark gene sets with full ranked lists.
  Results saved to Hallmark/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("Hallmark", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_hallmark_genesets}
# ============================================================
# LOAD HALLMARK GENE SETS FROM MSIGDB
# Category H = Hallmark gene sets
# 50 curated gene sets representing well-defined biological
# states or processes
# ============================================================

hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(
  species  = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

cat("Hallmark gene sets loaded:",
    length(unique(hallmark_sets$gs_name)), "\n")
```

```{r hallmark_ora_shared_genes}
# ============================================================
# HALLMARK ORA — SHARED ALS/PD GENES
# Over-representation analysis on the 43 shared genes
# ============================================================

shared_genes <- read.csv(
  "Consistency/ALS_PD_shared_genes.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% pull(gene)

cat("Shared ALS/PD genes:", length(shared_genes), "\n")

hallmark_shared <- enricher(
  gene          = shared_genes,
  TERM2GENE     = hallmark_sets,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

if(!is.null(hallmark_shared) &&
   nrow(hallmark_shared@result) > 0){

  cat("Significant Hallmark terms (shared ALS/PD):",
      nrow(hallmark_shared@result), "\n")
  print(hallmark_shared@result %>%
          dplyr::select(Description, GeneRatio, p.adjust) %>%
          head(10))

  p <- dotplot(hallmark_shared, showCategory = 20) +
    labs(title = "Hallmark Enrichment — Shared ALS/PD Genes")

  ggsave("Hallmark/ALS_PD_shared_Hallmark_dotplot.png",
         plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

  write.csv(hallmark_shared@result,
            "Hallmark/ALS_PD_shared_Hallmark.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No significant Hallmark terms for shared genes\n")
}
```

```{r hallmark_gsea_per_dataset}
# ============================================================
# HALLMARK GSEA — PER DATASET
# Full ranked gene lists used for GSEA with Hallmark sets
# Key expected finding: MYOGENESIS in ALS/PD
# ============================================================

hallmark_gsea_datasets <- c(
  "GSE3307",   # ALS primary
  "GSE140089", # PD primary
  "GSE128177"  # PD replication
)

for(gse_id in hallmark_gsea_datasets){
  cat("\n--- Hallmark GSEA:", gse_id, "---\n")

  try({
    df <- read.csv(
      paste0("DE_Results/", gse_id, "_DE_results.csv"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # ranked gene list
    ranked <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
      mutate(rank = sign(log2FC) * -log10(pvalue + 1e-300)) %>%
      arrange(desc(rank))

    gene_list        <- ranked$rank
    names(gene_list) <- ranked$gene

    # GSEA with Hallmark
    hallmark_gsea <- GSEA(
      geneList      = gene_list,
      TERM2GENE     = hallmark_sets,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
      verbose       = FALSE
    )

    if(nrow(hallmark_gsea@result) > 0){
      cat("Significant Hallmark terms:",
          nrow(hallmark_gsea@result), "\n")

      p <- dotplot(hallmark_gsea,
                   split        = ".sign",
                   showCategory = 15) +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
        labs(title = paste(gse_id, "Hallmark GSEA"))

      ggsave(
        paste0("Hallmark/", gse_id, "_Hallmark_GSEA_dotplot.png"),
        plot  = p,
        width = 12,
        height = 10,
        dpi   = 300
      )

      write.csv(
        hallmark_gsea@result,
        paste0("Hallmark/", gse_id, "_Hallmark_GSEA.csv"),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      cat("No significant Hallmark terms for:", gse_id, "\n")
    }
  })
}

cat("\nHallmark analysis complete.\n")
cat("Results saved to Hallmark/\n")
list.files("Hallmark")
```
